incidents.title: Emergency Maintenance
incidents.description: Genesis AI is currently undergoing emergency maintenance due to a major website issue. Services may be temporarily unavailable.

incidents.title: Message Delivery Failure
incidents.description: Issues with message delivery where users found that messages were not sending or were stuck in a loop. Resolved by the afternoon.

incidents.title: Partial slowdown in response times
incidents.description: We noticed higher than usual wait times for some queries. The core infrastructure has now fully recovered.

incidents.title: Website loading issues for some users
incidents.description: A small non-functional problem caused the website to not load correctly for a subset of users. The issue was identified and resolved quickly.
